description.value: Westcoast Poké is a BC-based poke bowl chain emphasizing chef-inspired flavours, fresh ingredients, and sustainable practices, with fully customizable bowls built from proteins like ahi tuna, sockeye salmon, and tofu. Located in a unit on Steveston Highway in Richmond, it offers online ordering and catering alongside in-store dining. The Steveston area is a popular cycling destination, making this a convenient stop for riders exploring the Fraser River delta routes.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack at 16m; rack (covered) at 76m; rack (covered) at 89m; rack (covered) at 100m.
